_source: Puppet Master. Linux Mint's Cinnamon desktop, installed as a desktop recipe on the shared Ubuntu 24.04 sandbox base (like the Zorin look). Cinnamon comes from Ubuntu's universe packages; Mint's own packages are not on Ubuntu's archive, so the menu, panel and window manager are Cinnamon's, with Mint's familiar layout.
title: Linux Mint (Cinnamon desktop)
description: Linux Mint's Cinnamon desktop: a modern panel, a start menu, the Nemo file manager and a familiar Mint layout. Heavier than the light desktop, lighter than a full GNOME.
